Correction recorded: an earlier checkpoint stated organizations.verified is never self-assigned; that was verified only for UPDATE. INSERT is unguarded (F1). H2 is therefore remediated for control independence only. Docs corrected: docs/passport/PASSPORT_AUTHORITY_AND_PUBLIC_PROJECTION.md and docs/security/passport-v2-independent-review.md.

Production: no Supabase migration applied, no production database write, no secret change, no deployment triggered by this session. Vercel preview deployments were created by repo automation on push. All database work was against throwaway local Docker Postgres.

blockers: F1 (HIGH, open): organizations.verified is guarded on UPDATE only, so INSERT with verified=true defeats H2's FLOW-verified-organization leg (control independence is unaffected).
F2 (MEDIUM, open): a host can complete their own activity and obtain a public 'Verified by Flow' claim.

R11-DB (MEDIUM, open, product-policy dependent): a member-created participation.activity claim, peer-verified, is accepted by a consented passport_disclose('claim_valid'); it never reaches the public projection.
F3 (LOW, open): claims guard trigger is UPDATE-only; service_role can INSERT a verified claim.
